topics.description: The Houston Independent School District (HISD) is under federal investigation for its plans to restructure special education services. This comes amid concerns that the district may be separating children with disabilities, which could be a violation of their civil rights.
topics.reason: Federal investigation into HISD's special education services

topics.description: Medicaid fraud fears are growing amid a massive red state billing spike in the sector that also plagued Minnesota. This has raised concerns about the potential for widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system.
topics.reason: Medicaid fraud fears grow amid massive red state billing spike
